originalText: 為了慶祝建成60週年，建於1955年的加州迪士尼樂園在2015年夏天開始長達一年的鑽石週年慶典，在慶典快結束之前，16年春天的時候，我和老公用了一個長週末去了一下Anaheim的迪士尼樂園。鑽石慶典當真不同凡響，有包含所有著名角色的超大彩車遊行 (Paint the Night)，絢麗奪目的彩色世界水舞 (World of Color)，裝飾著閃亮D的睡美人城堡，更不要說特別策劃的盛大煙火 (Disneyland Forever)，玩得盡興，玩得舒服。 而我最喜歡的紀念品部分，也相當有鑽石週年的華麗特色。這一對為了鑽石週年特別推出的當家明星米奇米妮套組，工藝十分精美，陶瓷製品，不同於一般紀念品的塑料或毛絨質地，很適合迪士尼粉絲收藏和在家中精品櫃中擺放。裝飾的細節中有很多水晶元素，比如米奇西裝的袖口和下襬部分，米妮的蝴蝶結和整身裙子都鑲嵌著亮閃閃的水鑽。我們已在家中擺放約略一年，一直都放在顯眼的位置，真的是好喜歡。這幾天想拍照po出來跟同樣喜歡迪士尼的粉絲分享，大概google了一下，很可惜已經沒有正式的販賣渠道了。 米奇米妮雙人正面，比一般的迪士尼玩具套組大很多，大約兩倍。 迪士尼樂園鑽石週年紀念品 米奇單人，面部和身體比例特別精緻。 迪士尼樂園鑽石週年米奇_正面 米奇細節。領結，襯衫，和西裝都特別漂亮，也和當時遊行以及水幕表演裡米奇的裝束一致，鑽石主題。 迪士尼鑽石週年米奇_細節 米妮單人，手鐲，裙擺和領口的部分非常華麗。 迪士尼鑽石週年米妮_正面 米妮的鞋子，藍色的水鑽和珍珠狀的鞋帶搭在一起太合適不過了。 迪士尼鑽石週年米妮_細節 最近在想又到了去玩一個主題樂園的季節了，還沒去過環球影城的哈利波特城堡，希望可以找時間去一下，也再淘淘看Universal的商品，哈哈，真是到哪裡都能買呢！

originalText: My husband and I just returned from a 2-week vacation in Japan. We had lots of fun there enjoying the urban vibes in Tokyo and the amazing history and cultures in Kyoto. Of course we shopped a lot and purchased several interesting souvenirs, products, and Japan exclusive items. Out of all the things, this Steamcream has been the best purchase for its uniqueness and effectiveness! I had no idea what Steamcream was before traveling in Japan. I watched a couple of youtubers recommending drugstore cosmetics prior to leaving for our trip but no one even mentioned this cream. Surprisingly, when we shopped in the department stores and fashionable places in Japan, I had always seen these cute tins on the first counter next to the escalator as well as being the No.1 recommendation by the stores. After having seen them a few times and finally tested at Shibuya Loft, I decided to bring one home and I selected this limited edition named as 377 Hanako. What is Steamcream? It is a very simple all-in-one multipurpose moisturizing cream that can be used both on your face and body. “Our pioneering STEAMCREAM formula – pure and light – deeply hydrates, softens and calms skin. It lifts the signs of fatigue and stree, and restores vitality and energy, giving skin a healthy, sparkling radiance.” Steamcream is enriched with natural ingredients which maximize the performance by using a steam technique. “We’ve used a shot of steam to extract the nutrients of oats, orange flower water and chamomile oil, fusing these with essential oils of rose, lavender and orange blossom, to ensure that the virtues of each and every ingredient is optimized, along with the cream’s absorption by the skin.” A natural and vegan beauty brand. “STEAMCREAM ingredients come from sustainable suppliers who comply with our non-animal testing policy.” The Packaging This cute and graphic packaging was designed by a Japanese game designer Hiroyuki Takahashi 高橋宏之. All Steamcream products come in this type of tins with twisting lids that are very lightweight yet sturdy. Steamcream Hanako — the Packaging Steamcream Hanako — the Back Test the Cream I’ve been using this cream nonstop for almost three weeks and enjoying it so much. The Scent Steamcream has no fragrance scent. Better than that, it has a very soothing spa type of smell which could come from its essential oil ingredients. The Texture It has a super light and even cloudy texture. The most similar thing I could think of is yogurt. On the Body This lightweight cream is so moisturizing without any greasiness. As you may know, it is very dry in Japan, especially in its cold and windy winter. On the first couple of days, every night when we came back to our hotel room, after the shower I had to apply a thick layer of moisturizing lotion onto my body and layers of skincare onto my face to avoid any dry flakiness. The first night after purchasing the Steamcream, I tried it on my body immediately when stepping out of the shower room. Surprisingly, only a very thin layer was enough and I found my body skin smooth and hydrated after 10 hours of resting and sleeping. On the Face On our flight back to San Francisco, I only had a moisturizing spray and the Steamcream to keep my skin hydrated in my makeup bag. Usually I would have my Laneige sleeping mask which could last over 6 hours for keeping my face moisturized. The Steamcream’s moisturizing power was so long last and effective! The flight was about 9 hours and I didn’t need to wash my face and reapply! My face was so soft and smooth without irritations or dryness. Overall Thoughts The Steamcream I bought had 75g of product and cost me 1620 Japanese Yen (about 14 dollars including tax) which was a very good price thinking of its awesome quality. I primarily used it as my body lotion and hand cream but found no problem using it on my face when I need more moisturizer (I live in the Bay Area and it rained A LOT this winter). I will keep using my Steamcream and will definitely repurchase it on their website https://www.steamcream.com/ that supports international delivery!

originalText: (以下文章包含電影劇透 spoiler alert!) 12月一直是我整年都很期待的時節，有我最愛的聖誕節，有舒服的假期，有無限暢飲也不膩的熱可可。對於愛看電影的影迷來說，12月也是個不錯的月份，因為聖誕新年檔期而扎堆的高成本大片一部又一部（今年的Rogue One/俠盜一號和Passenger/太空旅客都相當強勢，鋪天蓋地的宣傳想不關注都難），而臨近來年春天得獎季，很多高口碑文藝電影也選擇在歲末檔期上映。其中最吸引我和老公的就是這一部La La Land，她是好萊塢久違了的音樂劇電影，自威尼斯電影節首映後斬獲無數獎項的高分製作，擁有即便是在大製作裡也非常有競爭力的Ryan Gosling和Emma Stone的卡司陣容。當天滿滿的觀影上座率也印證了La La Land就是今冬最令人期待的文藝電影。 以下簡單羅列幾個我認為La La Land的觀影亮點: 整部影片的第一個場景，在觀眾還沒有看到帥男靚女的主人公之前，就感受到超級精彩的一鏡到底的公路歌舞劇。整部影片中可以發現很多長鏡頭的運用，雖然是影音作品，但很多場景舞台感強烈（倒是讓我想起最近很流行的Mannequin Challenge假人挑戰）。 全片都能夠用聲音、形體、音樂等音樂劇元素講故事，所有的動態和神韻都是有情緒表達的，十分豐富。 光影的運用特別奇妙，主人公獨唱的時候總會暗下周圍場景，一束追光灑在他或她身上，靜謐而隆重，留下時間和空間讓觀眾細細傾聽和觀賞。 主演們的演技當然是很精彩的。威尼斯最佳女演員Emma Stone真是可愛又動人，印象最深刻的場景就是她扮演的Mia與約會對象和朋友們double date的時候，在場的人說著Mia不認同沒有共情的話題，她的表情和細微的肢體變化，由欲融入到疑惑再到自我抽離最後下定決心，特別流暢和引起共鳴。逃出餐廳往男主人公Sebastian等她的影院奔跑，Emma Stone小幅扭動的身軀，臉上笑開了花但又帶點羞澀的雀躍表情，真的是我最喜歡的表達愛情和喜悅的場景。Ryan Gosling好像是扮演平民執著男的代表，在他另一部好片Blue Valentine裡他演的也是一個固執堅守自己生活模式的深情男，生活的艱難，夢想的遙不可及，每日反覆的信念，但最終還是這樣過下去吧，並且好好守護所愛的女人雖然她終將遠去那樣的男人，是他特別令人喜歡的角色類型。 似夢似真的舞蹈場景真的完全令人感動。在Griffith Observatory裡面兩個人飛到空中共舞的那一幕，遇到那個能互相了解互相鼓勵分享愛與愁的人，就好像自由興奮得飛向了空中，滿滿的幸福感。（到LA旅行的話很推薦到這裡一游，真的是很好玩景色也很棒的地方） 音樂和歌曲當然是非常棒的，推薦完整的原聲專輯，一個人沈靜的時候，兩個人幸福的時候，大家一起出門運動登山的時候，都是非常適合的。 關於夢想 To the fools who dream, to the mess we make. 無望，但熱愛；挫折，但堅守。這種苦澀的築夢過程真的動人心弦。 成為成功的女演員，是Mia的夢想；開一間演奏傳統爵士的club，是Sebastian的夢想。La La Land，可以是LA Hollywood的可愛別名，可以是美妙的夢想之地的意思。這影片名字就透露著夢想，最令觀眾達到共情的大概也是她對夢想的描繪。來自內華達的Mia一邊在咖啡館裡泡咖啡，一邊繁忙的參與各類試鏡，有時候演著演著動情的哭戲，試鏡導演卻在打電話或討論自己吃什麼（這一段改編自Ryan Gosling自己的真實經歷科科）。受Seb的啟發，Mia決定不再陷入被挑選的無限循環，開始自編自導自演舞台劇，但上座率寥寥無幾，還無意中聽到觀看的人背後對自己天份和實力的嘲諷。灰心喪氣後卻意外得到喜愛自己舞台劇試鏡導演給的機會，一舉踏上表演的坦途。 傳統爵士鋼情演奏家Sebastian對爵士樂逐漸消亡的現狀感到痛苦，一心想重振爵士表演的輝煌。中間遇到曾經的同學，John Legend扮演的新派爵士音樂家Keith，Keith勸Seb加入自己的樂隊The Messengers，“How are you gonna be a revolutionary if you’re such a traditionalist? You’re holding onto the past, but Jazz is about the future.” 固守傳統的一切，技法韻律節奏表演風格，如何能達到Seb想要的重新煥發？感覺影片到最後也沒有這個層面的解答。Seb確實創立了自己的俱樂部，讓他心中的好爵士樂有了一個空間可以生存，但還並不是他更大的那個夢想。按照現在流行的企業文化教育，Keith和Seb都屬於傑出的Inside out式的做事模式，這是極受推崇的思考行動模式，自己先有一個發想，並創造性的實現它。對比之下，Keith的樂隊完全擁抱新時代的音樂元素，電子、貝斯、和帶有其他音樂風格的唱腔；Seb欣賞的是那純純的帶有誕生的喜悅的爵士風格，沒有制式，充滿變化和未知的演奏。這樣的情節設置很有意思，但最終影片也沒有給Seb一個關於他的夢想進一步的呈現，“純粹的傳統如何是變革式的？” 關於愛情 上面寫了很多La La Land給我的感受，但愛情才是看完該片我最想表達的地方。影片趨近結尾的時候，交代了五年後兩人的生活，他們並沒有走到一起。Mia已經結婚並有一個女兒，過著成功女演員富足又幸福的生活。螢幕上Mia和老公親吻的時候，影院裡迴盪著觀眾們的驚呼，帶一點遺憾，帶一點不解。另一邊Seb已經成為傳統爵士俱樂部Seb’s的老闆，有很多志同道合的朋友一起享受音樂，偶爾也自己下場演奏一番。一個晚上，出來約會的Mia夫婦無意中走進了Seb’s，Mia認出了曾經她和Seb一起的時候她設計的爵士club的標誌。給一首歌的時間，代表兩人的City of Stars，台上演奏和哼唱的Seb，台下陷入惆悵和幻想的Mia。一切回到初見，Seb更熱情，Mia更堅定，在他們生命的每一個路口，兩人都在寬容理解支持對方上做到最好，仿佛真的生活在完美的La La Land中，沒有頹廢，沒有爭執，沒有糾結，也沒有放棄。最後王子和公主過著美好的生活。 這樣的故事，是觀眾最期盼的吧。不過這樣的故事，就是好萊塢的俗套愛情，不是關於夢想和真實的La La Land。恰恰是這個結局提升了整部影片，因為這是個真實人生會有的結局，並且是順理成章的。如果他們真的在一起，我反而會感覺很怪異，因為除了都是熱忱追求夢想的人，Mia和Seb並沒有更多的互相認同的理念（不過最後Mia丈夫的形象又簡單的落入了可靠商務人士的俗套中，很草率的感覺）。回到Keith和Seb對於Jazz的爭論，前面討論過，Keith更開闊，活在當下，擁抱當下，而Seb更自我，認為如果一件事是好的，不需要別人，特別是大量的別人也認同。這是觀念的不同，在Keith和Seb的關係中決定了他們不會長久的合作下去。在這個交叉路口上，Mia與Seb想法並不一樣，她相信藝術始終需要觀眾，需要更多人的喜愛，她支持的是Seb一定要尊重自己選擇，從那一刻開始，我覺得他們更像是一起追夢的partner，每當一個人要放棄另覓途徑的時候，另一人就拉他／她回來，喚起那個真正的夢想。這樣的關係不一定會成為事業和生活都共享的人生伴侶。前者不需要無私和妥協，後者恰恰需要。也許可以融合，但年輕的兩人打碎了愛情的夢境之後很難再拼和上，可謂是錯誤的時間說不清是錯是對的人。 因為這個有點苦澀的結局，讓這部片更值得好好觀賞。影片故事背景是帶點懷舊味道的，但表達的情緒和理念卻很引起共鳴，是一部真誠又真實的電影。

originalText: 迪士尼的16年感恩節動畫電影“海洋奇緣”(Moana)已經在12月初獲得了近兩億美元的全球票房，成為迪士尼動畫的又一熱門影片。這部電影以太平洋群島原住民文化為基礎，講述了一個勇敢的女孩兒Moana和半神Maui穿越大洋尋找讓海洋和島嶼擺脫黑暗恢復生機的冒險故事。電影我是非常推薦的，主角是一個棕色皮膚的小女孩兒，可愛、勇敢、堅定，歌曲好聽動人，其他人物也都感人逗趣，非常值得闔家觀賞的一部影片。 趁著電影大熱，迪士尼也推出了配套周邊迷你玩偶套裝，製作十分精良，人物還原度頗高，很值得迪士尼或Moana的粉絲購買收藏，作為聖誕節和新年，甚至春節禮物也都再恰當不過了。 Moana Figure Play Set 包裝 Packaging 此玩偶套裝包含10個小玩偶，均是電影裡面的重要角色。 Maui as Hawk 半神毛伊變成大胖鳥 2. Toddler Moana 莫阿娜小時候 3. Pua and Heihei 莫阿娜的兩個寵物小夥伴，非常好笑的喔 4. Kakamora 小椰子海盜，看起來可愛實際非常兇悍的呃 5. Moana 少女莫阿娜，電影裡面她反覆提到，她不是公主，不是公主，不是公主，好吧，所以她不應該叫海洋公主，她就是莫阿娜，海島族長的女兒 6. Demi God Maui 半神毛伊 背部的細節也都非常不錯～～～ 7. Te Kā 熔漿惡魔，她的故事貫穿始終，實際是失去了心的Te Fiti女神的憤怒化身，很感人的橋段 8. Gramma Tala 塔拉祖母，是最疼愛也最理解和鼓勵莫阿娜的自由探索精神的人 9. Chief Tui 圖伊酋長，莫阿娜的父親，一直反對莫阿娜親近海洋冒險的人，但也是最保護莫阿娜的人 10. Tamatoa 椰子蟹怪，很執著於自己歌聲的monster，眼神很邪魅滴 整組玩偶打折過後大概18塊美金，還是相當不錯的價格，推薦大家送禮或收藏，看過電影後繼續保留電影裡面的愛與勇氣吧！

originalText: In my last blog post, I shared my in-flight beauty essentials checklist and briefly went through some key products and the skin care routine I recommended to keep you moisturized while taking flights(click here to read it). In this post, I’m sharing with you my checklist for the items you may need in the carry-on bag you take with you onto the plane. Below is the downloadable pdf document. My Carry-on Bag Organization_Checklist Must-Have Items Documents. A legal ID such as passport and driver’s license is a must-have when traveling. Remember to check the expiration date on your passport before leaving the country you’re living in. Print out the reservation pages including the flights, hotels, amusement parts and special events you are about to attend during your trip. Having them on your phone is also convenient plus it’s saving lots of paper. The only downside of using digital version is that your phone may not be working well when you need it to be (sometimes my phone was out of battery or the load speed of the page was extremely low when I really needed to get the reservation information). Cellphone and phone chargers. Well, who doesn’t need it? Wallet. Make sure you have your cash and credit/debit card ready and usable in your destination. Pens and notepads. In case you’ll need to fill out some forms on the international flights. Keys. Good-To-Have Items Cosmetic/toiletry bag. See my last post. Pharmacy bag. It’s always good to have a “walking pharmacy” with you. The container could be a small pouch or a multi-compartment pill box. I like to have a mini size eye drop, some band-aids, Advil, and a pair of earplugs in my “walking pharmacy”. Cottonelle wipes.They are wet and soft, sturdy and flushable. I feel these wipes work much better than facial tissues in the restroom. Ipad/Ipod/Laptop and chargers. To make you entertained and relaxed. Earphones. In case you don’t want to use the headphones the airlines provide. Scarf/Jacket. Usually it is very dry and cold up in the air. A long scarf or a jacket can keep you warm and comfy. Travel pillow and Sleep mask. Good for your neck and low back when sleeping. Snacks. Bring the snacks that are small and compact as well as provide good nutrition and energy with your, especially for the long flights. They really help! I like All kinds of chocolate/nut bars. Books and Magazines.

originalText: 又到年末了，大家都開始準備要在過年過節期間去旅行了吧。所以我在這裡給大家分享我自己的機艙化妝包物品清單(checklist)。可能很多po文都會介紹機艙必備美妝品啦或者保養品推薦，但為了大家更方便，我就來提供一個可下載的pdf清單列表，大家可以按照這個模式製作自己的或者就用我提供的來進行行前準備，hoho~~~ 點機艙化妝包物品清單 來下載哦 按照這個清單來整理化妝小物，我來給大家介紹我一直以來的艙內護膚保養步驟 噴上護髮噴霧或擦免洗護髮乳霜，輕輕按摩，然後把頭髮綁起來，單股或雙股隨意 用水狀卸妝產品卸掉臉上的妝容（我在不化妝時也會用這個步驟來清潔臉部） 噴上臉部保濕噴霧，輕拍吸收 在臉上和脖子上抹上保濕功能的凝膠(gel)狀面膜，並按摩吸收至略幹，如果想要效果增強，可以分兩次，第一層稍微薄一點，第二層加固 抹上眼霜或精華，如果是長程飛行，會每個三小時補擦一次 塗上護唇膏 塗上護手霜和指緣油 如果有痘痘問題，可以擦上痘痘藥 在長飛行中可以幾個小時後洗掉面膜後再重複以上動作 降落前40-45分鐘用卸妝水擦拭掉面膜，擦上臉部保養乳液，上一點遮瑕霜或氣墊粉底，再用潤色唇膏提亮唇色和臉頰 這樣一定保證肌膚水噹噹，落地後即刻好心情開始遊玩！

originalText: Every year, My husband and I kick off the holiday season by booking our annual winter trip. While busy looking for good deals on hotels and flights, I always begin to prepare the travel essentials I am about to pack in my carry-on a month before the actual trip. Today I wanted to share the checklist of my in-flight beauty essentials in my TSA approved cosmetic bag (click In-FlightEssentials to get the PRINTABLE pdf document!). And in my next blog posts, I will introduce other items you may need in your carry-on bag. The Bag To Start, you’ll need a cosmetic/toiletry bag that meets the TSA regulations. I recommend a clear, zippered, plastic/vinyl 1-quart sized bag like this one I found on Amazon for all of your beauty/makeup items instead of having two or three pouches for liquid, non-liquid, and toiletries separately. It will become your one-stop beauty place on the airplane which is more convenient and trouble-free. In-Flight Beauty Items You may already read a lot about the beauty essentials needed while taking flights or have your own favorite ones. Here I will only quickly go through my favorites without going into too much detail and briefly explain why I like to have them in my carry-on. Cleansing water. I like to use a non-residue, non-sticky cleansing water to clean my face after on-boarding. Even you don’t wear makeup I still recommend you clean your face to get it prepared for the long trip. My favorite product is Bioderma Crealine H2O. Actually you can use any brand you like as long as it doesn’t break you out or dry out your skin. I used to use face wipes but still needed to wash my face so I switched to the water based product. Hair Conditioner. To protect your hair from getting dry or damaged, a good hair conditioning spray or hydrating cream is a must-have. I usually go to a drugstore and grab the smallest sized one. All affordable and worked well! Hand Cream. My go-to hand cream is the L’Occitane shea butter. I know there are lots of good hand creams out there, pick up your favorite in the travel size ^_^ Cuticle Cream. Skip this one if you don’t normally use one or your hand cream is moisturizing enough to be used on cuticles. My fav is Burt’s Bees Lemon Butter Cuticle Cream which is also many people’s favorite. Face Cream with SPF. After cleaning your face or the mask you put on during your flight, you’ll definitely need a good moisturizer. No matter in the air or on the ground, a sun block is always good for your skin. I am using Murad Essential-C Day Moisture, which gives very good moisturizing result and enough sun protection. Face Moisturizing Spray. Use it when you feel a bit dry on your skin. Caudalie’s Beauty Elixir is a very good one. Face Gel Mask. When on a super long flight (> 5 hours), better to apply a thick layer of clear gel face mask after cleaning your face and neck. I’ve tried different moisturizers, the result of them cannot compare to that of the gel mask/sleeping mask. Only the mask gave me a strong shield protecting my skin from constantly loosing water in the extreme dry environment. Laneige’s sleep mask is the stellar product. Nügg Hydrating Face Mask is a more affordable and one-time use option. Eye Cream/Serum. Get your fav one with you and apply it along with the face mask. Lip Balm with SPF. Nivea Shea Butter & Aloe moisturizes your lips and gives good sun protection at the same time. Tinted Lip Balm. I use it before landing to make sure I look ok after getting off the plane. Clinique Chubby Stick Baby Tint Moisturizing Lip Colour Balm in Poppin’ Poppy and Dior Addict Lip Glow in Coral are my favorites. Both are super hydrating and leave beautiful natural tint on lips. Liquid Concealer. Dot a bit on the hyperpigmentations and spots and blend in before getting off. Cushion BB Cream. If you prefer to have an all face coverage, the concealer would be optional and a cushion becomes a good alternative. It only takes 20 seconds to cover your entire face and offers hydration, good coverage, sun protection and long lasting effect. Laneige is my ultimate favorite BB Cushion. Q-tips. Optional when you don’t wear makeup. Cotton Pads. Use them to clean your face with cleansing water. Deodorant Towelettes. To prevent you from smelling bad after hours of being seated and sleeping in a small and close environment. Tissues. Wipes/Sanitizers. Sanitize your hands whenever you need to touch your face. Blotting Paper. If you have combination to oily skin like I do, blotting paper is a must-have. Hair Ties. Travel Hair Comb. When you hairs are dry and fuzzy, put on some hair cream and comb through. The compact and portable one from Sephora is really convenient and easy to travel with. In-Flight Skincare Routine Lisa Eldridge had filmed a video on how she did her skincare on the airplane which is easy to follow and super effective. To summarize her routine: Apply hair hydrating cream/hair conditioning spray and tie hair back Use cleansing water and cotton pads to remove makeup (I wouldn’t skip this step even I don’t wear makeup) Use elixir spray and pat in Apply face mask and massage in Apply eye cream and repeat it every a few hours Use lip balm on lips Cream on cuticles and hands Use blemish spot treatment if any Rinse face and repeat the above during long flight 45 minutes before landing, use cleansing water and cotton pads to remove the gel mask, apply moisturizer, spot conceal, and use the tinted balm on lips and cheeks (or cream blush). Then, you will look fabulous even after long flights and enjoy your trip from the very beginning (=^_^=) Happy holiday!
